items.missing: Modern loss-rate data (Ukraine air war, 1991, 2003) to calibrate
items.reason: Exactly in Ball, unlinked.

items.name: Sortie generation rate and its drivers (turnaround, basing distance, tanker support)
items.reason: Every air-campaign claim (Israel vs Iran ranges, Taiwan) needs it; Ball mentions sorties only.

items.name: Historical loss rates per day/sortie by era
items.missing: Air loss rates by era present (Ball) but unmapped; ground/naval loss rates per day (Dupuy-style) and modern drone-era loss data missing.
items.reason: Order-of-magnitude reference for checking claims.

items.name: Hughes salvo model and staying power
items.missing: Hughes salvo equations (striking power, staying power, defensive power, scouting), "fire effectively first", stochastic critique (Armstrong)
items.reason: The standard model for naval combat; absent from every library book.

items.name: Value of information and scouting effectiveness in salvo models
items.missing: Scouting effectiveness and VoI in the salvo model (Hughes: "fire effectively first"), detection-before-fire as decisive variable.
items.reason: Naval/ISR value argument.

items.name: VLS reload at sea and magazine constraints
items.missing: VLS magazine depth, at-sea reload limits, magazine-depth vs salvo-size arithmetic

items.name: Missile stockpiles and production estimates of adversaries
items.missing: Estimating adversary missile stockpiles and production (OSINT: launch counts, factory imagery, budget docs).
items.reason: Needed for magazine-depth arguments.

items.missing: Interceptor production rates (PAC-3, SM-3/6, THAAD, Arrow, Tamir) vs consumption; depletion curves.

items.name: Munitions expenditure in high-intensity war vs stockpiles
items.missing: Expenditure rates (Ukraine 155 mm ~5-20k/day vs US production), interceptor expenditure vs stock (Israel 2024, Red Sea SM-2/SM-6), magazine depth as strategic variable.
items.reason: Core current issue; articles weekly.

items.name: Interceptor and munition production rate vs expenditure rate as a war-duration model (stock-flow)
items.reason: Unifies LOG.2.1 and ACQ.4.1; the central 2024-26 debate.

items.reason: Raised S->K.

items.reason: Links ISR, C2 latency and strike; Scud-hunt and TEL-hunting analysis.

items.name: Checking interceptor-performance claims (Patriot 1991 Postol/Lewis debate, 2024 Iran raids, Ukraine)
items.reason: Authority writing; claims checking.

items.name: Interception rate and kill claim analysis (denominators, definitions)
items.missing: Interception-rate claims: denominators (engaged vs launched vs threatening), definitions of kill, partial intercepts.
items.reason: War reporting.

items.missing: Claims vs verified intercepts (Patriot 1991 Postol debate, Iron Dome), definitions of "intercept".
items.reason: War claims.

items.missing: Missing: wargame design (objectives, scenario, adjudication: rigid/free/matrix, cell structure), matrix games, analytic vs educational games, data capture.
